[[File:Wolf icon.png|left]]
'''Wolves''' are canine enemies that can be found in various places around [[Gielinor]]. They have a variety of different combat levels, but level 11 wolves are the most common and can be found on [[White Wolf Mountain]], and level 8 wolves only being found in the [[Stronghold of Security]]. They can be a slayer assignment for low-level players.

Their [[wolf bones|bones]] can be used with a [[chisel]] to create [[Wolf bone arrowheads]] used to make [[ogre arrow]]s, which are necessary for completing [[Big Chompy Bird Hunting]] and [[Recipe for Disaster: Freeing Skrach Uglogwee|Freeing Skrach Uglogwee]] during [[Recipe for Disaster]]. The bones are also used to create [[Spirit wolf pouch]]es.
